name: Coinbase BTC update velocity
description: How fast Coinbase Exchange BTC-USD is updating. quote_updates_1s and quote_updates_10s count admitted best-quote updates (the ticker channel's best bid and ask) over the trailing one and ten seconds; trades_1s and trades_10s count admitted trades over the same windows; midpoint_changes_10s counts the admitted quote updates in the last ten seconds whose midpoint differed from the previously admitted one, so requoting without price movement is visible as motion without price discovery. velocity_ratio compares the ten-second quote rate with the trailing baseline rate over baseline_window_ms of observed lane time, capped at five minutes (a research default): it is (quote_updates_10s / 10 s) divided by (baseline_quote_updates / baseline window), formed as a single exact ratio so nothing rounds before the comparison. One means the venue is updating at its own recent average. Before any baseline exists the ratio has no denominator, so velocity_ratio_present is false and velocity_ratio is left at zero rather than fabricated - the same presence idiom book_resilience uses for recovery_ms. Every count is a fold over admitted event times, never a wall clock, so a replay of the same admissions reproduces every number. This identity is single-venue by construction: it counts only Coinbase's own admitted events and is independent of the other spot venues, so one venue's fault degrades this reading alone. Not ready until ten seconds of lane time have been observed since the venue's first admitted event, so the ten-second counts are complete rather than partial; while warming the instance-status reason is coinbase_warming_up, and while the venue is marked unavailable it is coinbase_venue_unavailable and the counters are cleared so they re-warm on reconnection. The counters are rolling market-relative state and are deliberately not checkpointed: they re-warm after a restart. No blended btc.external.* variant of this measurement is published - a cross-venue update rate would have to rule how two venues' independent update streams combine, and that ruling is deferred pending evidence. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
